type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {r : σ → ℕ} {B α β : ℝ}
  {s : ℕ},
  (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    0 < B →
      ∑ j : σ, r j ≤ s →
        2 ^ s < β →
          (1 + |α|) ^ s ≤ β →
            (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
              ∀ (i k : σ →₀ ℕ),
                |(eval fun (x : σ) ↦ α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| <
                  β * (β * B) * β
